verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents official SDKs (e.g., Node.js via npm) and a REST API with docs, satisfying the core 'build against official SDKs' ask, but evidence only lists one SDK explicitly and lacks broader SDK language coverage, versioning, or independent developer corroboration; OpenAPI spec discovery also failed in probes.
